TOOL: cat jest.config.js 2>/dev/null || cat jest.config.mjs 2>/dev/null || ls jest.config.* 2>/dev/null; npx jest --version

Hold on before closing — I think that fix isn't doing anything.

`runInBand` is a **CLI flag only**. It has no counterpart in jest.config.js; Jest doesn't read it from config, and its validator emits an "Unknown option" warning rather than failing, so the file looks fine while the suite still forks workers.
